problems.note: Verification limitation, not a demonstrated numerical or coding error. The supplied PDF has no appended or embedded supplement, and the complete markdown ends with the references. No matching supplement was found in the searched local Dropbox files or Downloads. Independent urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to the named Springer supplement URL and then the Springer article URL both failed with WinError 10013. Consequently, the required completeness check cannot be certified for the online appendices. This limitation is already acknowledged in the extraction. No particular missing estimate, additional count, or corrected value is asserted; unavailable values remain null.

summary: Independently checked all 16 estimates against the supplied paper and extraction rules. Read all 124086 characters of the markdown, including the references, and extracted the cited PDF pages with PyMuPDF. All recorded numerical statistics and counts match the correct outcome and randomized-arm contrast. The common analyzed sample is 75; the four human-level shortlist-rating records appropriately leave their analysis counts null, because final counts are not printed after the reported own-shortlist exclusions or for the GPT-4 variants. The unlabeled group sizes of 38 and 37 do not justify assigning counts to named arms. Question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, AI availability, timing, within-person status, comparison type, and se_basis are consistent with the codebook. The dyads contain one human, and the analyses use one count or averaged score per participant. Good-Idea-Count measures count qualifying ideas; flexibility measures category breadth within a participant, not diversity across people. All ten supplied quotation warnings are false positives: the passages occur on their cited pages, with PDF ligatures, line-end hyphenation, subscripts, and font substitutions for plus and less-than signs accounting for the failed text matches. Visual inspection also confirmed the human-fluency negative rank-biserial effect and positive printed Cohen’s d, and the plus and less-than symbols. The human-fluency text p-value is 0.015; the conflicting figure significance notation is already disclosed in the extraction. All eight main outcomes and eight GPT-4/Good-Idea-Count variants reported for the randomized contrast in the saved article are present. Idea-origin comparisons, self-reports, and correlational mechanism analyses are appropriately excluded. No numerical, scope, or coding error was identified in the 16 recorded estimates, and no eligible contrast was found missing from the supplied article. The sole reported problem is the unresolved completeness check for unavailable online appendices; this report does not certify their contents.
